decisions.question: Resolve enrollment input before calling the existing registration API
decisions.chosen: Resolve enrollment input before calling the existing registration API
decisions.reasoning: Choose exactly one legacy, regular-file or non-interactive stdin source. Bound UTF-8 input to 16 KiB, follow projected Secret symlinks but bind reads to a checked descriptor, and emit fixed errors without paths or token values. Keep runtime enrollment, storage and transport behavior in the existing cloud API.
